entities.name: C'tan
entities.description: Oldest intelligent beings, energy creatures that acted as gods for the Necrons.

entities.name: Necrons
entities.description: Robotic beings created from the Necrontyr, who turned on the C'tan.

entities.name: Necrontyr
entities.description: Species who gave the C'tan physical form.

entities.name: Szarekh
entities.description: The Silent King who led the Necrons against the C'tan.

entities.name: Tesseract Labyrinths
entities.description: Multi-dimensional prisons holding the C'tan shards.

events.summary: The Necrons, led by Szarekh, turn on the C'tan and break them into shards held in Tesseract Labyrinths.
events.quote: the Necrons broke the C'tan into shards

relations.note: They turned on the C'tan for their betrayal.
relations.quote: eventually turned on the C'tan for their betrayal
